font_path.description: Path to the source OpenType/TrueType font file

point_size.description: Desired point size for the bitmap font

output_file.description: Path to the output BDF font file

platform_id.description: Platform ID for selecting character map (3=Microsoft, 1=Apple Unicode is 0)

encoding_id.description: Encoding ID for selecting character map (1=ISO10646/Unicode)

character_spacing.description: Character spacing type: P (Proportional), M (Monospace), C (Character Cell)

foundry_name.description: Foundry name used in the XLFD name

typeface_name.description: Typeface name used in the XLFD name

weight_name.description: Weight name used in the XLFD name (e.g., Medium, Bold)

slant_name.description: Slant name used in the XLFD name (R=Roman, I=Italic, O=Oblique)

width_name.description: Width name used in the XLFD name

additional_style_name.description: Additional style name used in the XLFD name

replace_char.description: Character used to replace dashes/spaces in font name

subset.description: Subset string defining character codes to generate (e.g., '60 70 80_90'). Empty means full font.

mapfile.description: Path to a mapping file for reencoding the BDF font. Empty means no remapping.
